prompts.name: grass
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art game ground material, not a screenshot or UI. Reference image is ONLY style/palette reference for the existing cozy isometric park props. Make a single square, perfectly seamless repeating ground texture, orthographic straight top-down. The code will project it onto an isometric map, so do not draw an isometric diamond, raised tile, borders, props, characters, text, grid, vignettes, spotlight, or object shadows. Pixel-art style with deliberate chunky pixel clusters and crisp nearest-neighbor edges, approximately 256x256 logical pixels enlarged to 1024x1024, limited harmonious palette, attractive hand-painted pixel material rather than noise or photorealism. Uniform soft daylight from upper left, similar detailed cozy game art as the reference. Fully opaque edge-to-edge, all four edges tile seamlessly with matching brightness and color. Material: lush neatly kept park lawn, warm light sage and yellow-green base near #bdcf98, medium olive recessed blades, bright warm pale-lime blade tips. Build a continuous rich mat of tiny short grass blades in softly varying clusters, little clover leaves, subtle flatter worn patches, very occasional miniature cream daisy heads or warm grass seeds (less than 2% surface). Grass has delicate 2-3 tone form shading but no black outlines. Lush yet calm enough to read small characters; avoid oversized tall tufts, bushes, dark holes, dirt patches, obvious repeating motif, stripes, and regular dot pattern. Surface detail should be as carefully drawn as reference leaves, at a much smaller ground-material scale.
